newsitem.title: USA: Channell to acquire Standby Electronics.
newsitem.headline: Channell to acquire Standby Electronics.

text.p: Channell Commercial Corp said Wednesday that it will acquire privately-held Standby Electronics Corporation, a manufacturer of metal fabricated enclosures to house advanced electronics, fiber optic cable, and power systems.
The terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
The company said that Standby's enclosures fill an area in network construction which Channell's existing product line does not cover.
Channell is a designer and manufacturer of precision-molded thermoplastic enclosures for broadband telecommunication applications. In 1996 it had net revenues of $47.3 million.
